A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at some point in [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to [[41 ABY]]. In 41 ABY, when [[New Jedi Order]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the [[Jedi enclave (Corellia)|Jedi enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], a [[Picture of meditating Jedi Master|picture]]&mdash;made before Grand Master Skywalker visited the [[Jedi academy|enclave]]&mdash;of her [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] was on one of the enclave's walls.<ref name="Betrayal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female Jedi Master first appeared albeit picture only in [[Aaron Allston]]'s novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'', the first entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Betrayal" />
